summary: Conditional RBAC can limit a role to job templates with certain tags: AAP labels sync as lowercase tags with special characters replaced by hyphens (Network-Automation becomes network-automation). Templates need synced labels and users need Execute in AAP; create a role such as network-templates for a team like network-team.
questions: How do I restrict portal templates to a team by label?
How do AAP labels become portal tags?
Conditional access in self-service automation portal
